title: Hangboard Protocol Load Grip Type Leaderboard
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hangboard:protocol
| stats avg(load_kg) as avg_value max(load_kg) as peak_value count as sessions by grip_type
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks grip type values by average and peak added load in kilograms, helping you see where hangboard protocol load performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which grip type contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `grip_type` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of grip type, average added load in kilograms, and peak added load in kilograms.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which grip type areas give you the strongest hangboard protocol load results.
